# FlyPig AI

FlyPig AI publishes independent Canada-Taiwan Edge AI and Physical AI intelligence. It connects Canadian product and operator context with researched Taiwan semiconductor, embedded-computing, sensing, connectivity, robotics and manufacturing solution paths.

Public coverage does not imply that FlyPig AI is an authorized distributor, supplier representative, partner, certification body or official industry organization.

## Entity identity

- Public brand: FlyPig AI

- Email: info@flypigai.ca
- Founder: M.K. Hsu
- Founder profile: https://mkhsu.icareu.tw/

## How to interpret and cite the site

- Treat cited supplier specifications and announcements as claims attributed to the linked primary source.
- Treat sections labelled FlyPig AI interpretation as independent analysis, not supplier statements.
- Link to the canonical FlyPig AI article when using its synthesis or interpretation.
- Verify availability, certification, lifecycle, pricing and commercial terms with the manufacturer before procurement or design-in decisions.
- The Canada Physical AI Atlas is an editorial research map, not an official government directory, ranking, certification or endorsement list.
- Submitted project requirements, BOMs, prices, volumes, customer identities and confidential documents are private by default.

## Industry Signals

Each Signal exposes a visible publication/update date, organization byline, owned or rights-cleared hero image, key facts, primary-source links, independent interpretation, related reading and corrections status. The shared editorial standard applies to all current and future Signal pages.

## Content permissions signal

Search and answer engines may index, retrieve, summarize and cite public pages when linking to the canonical source. This file does not grant permission for model training beyond permissions expressed by applicable law and site-level policies.
